verdict.rationale: Make documents a custom-apps developer platform for building connectors. It covers the app components Base, Connections, Webhooks, Modules and Remote Procedure Calls, plus a choice of editor. A TypeScript SDK covers most Make API endpoints. The evidence only lists these components, so the depth of the connector-building workflow is unproven. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the custom-app build, test and deploy workflow, evidence that a connector can be kept private or shared only within a team or organization, any official CLI or local development tooling for custom apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a connector.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: The Make Typescript SDK provides full support for type definitions and a majority of Make API endpoints, built-in error handling, and response typing.
